data.name: Esmaeel
data.gender_notes: Esmaeel is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Esmaeel is the name of the patriarch Ibrahim's (Abraham) son. According to Islamic tradition, Allah (God) gave Ibrahim this name because Allah heard Ibrahim's call to abandon his idols and follow the One God. In the Quran, Ibrahim is described as a prophet, an immigrant, and a man of deep faith. The name Esmaeel carries the meaning “God hearing” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Esmaeel usually hope their child will grow to embody god hearing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes submission to the will of Allah.
data.etymology: Esmaeel belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “God hearing.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Esmaeel total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
